summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn: the owner's tree-centered home, lake and creek, activity sites, and roads connect it to Hearthmere and Lumenvale. Authored scene rows anchor places and actors; terrain marks, procedural builders, shared data kits, and manager behaviors supply landscape, structures, and inhabitants. The world now also has a working rowboat fishing loop, Tower Gardens crop cycle, collectible forest mushrooms, and a dressed curved town corridor with a rampart and distant horizon layers.
places: places/main - forest world linking Spawn/home and lake, creek sites, camps/corral, north market town, Hearthmere and Lumenvale
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn hub: tree-centered home/studio, creek, activity sites and Tower Gardens behind the wizard tower at (57,-26); garden beds, seed stations, pump and greenhouse
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - lake/islet, maze, blossom walk and camps; dock/rowboat fishing reaches the lake and creek mouth
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene - market town around z≈100, square, hall/Ember, crowd, alleys and new low limestone town-rampart/service-yard boundary
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene + neighboring west/north forest cells - highway verge and many interactable wild-mushroom patches; added cells extend collectible clusters through forest
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene + x0z1.scene - winding Spawn-to-town lane, mile markers and corridor greenbelt; horizon hills/peaks and mist are distant non-colliding scene layers
places/main/cells/x-1z1.scene - garden-district blueprint row; adjacent district areas are authored/streamed in neighboring cells
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain/water, site/path/clearing marks and seeded vegetation; grading/clearing now follows the S-curve town lane and Tower Gardens ground

templates/player.js#player - player root with movement, locomotion, home interaction, delete, travel, alchemy and mount handlers
templates/camera.js#camera - custom first-/third-person camera; scripts/camera.js also pulls back when riding a controlled mount or seated rowboat
places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - configured terrain, height/material interface and landscape marks

move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; templates/player.js attaches home interaction, travel, alchemy and horse handlers
Z input -> scripts/horse-summon.js spawns session steed using steed data and courier-horse geometry -> scripts/steed.js controls horse/rider
player presses mandala-crystal -> harvest; alchemy-bench press -> alchemyOpen -> alchemy-player brew spends harvest and sets buff -> scripts/ui.js displays panel/status

west-pasture manager + pasture-flock.yml -> tagged sheep/alpaca goals and species clips; corral site/data -> corral-horses.js managed horse poses/clips
town-crowd.yml roster -> town-crowd.js citizens; town scene + town.json -> town square/house/hall/fountain/festoon/alleys and rampart builders; terrain path marks align with road geometry

scripts/gen/{horizon-ring,mist-banks,moss-boulder}.js - noninteractive distant terrain silhouettes/mist and seeded greenbelt rocks varied by layer/parameters

scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used
scripts/gen/garden-garb.js - crown/skirt geometry builder has no current scene or template references
migrationNotes: forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main river is at sea level y=0, ground around y=0.5, Spawn clearing near (0,-3).

Keep terrain material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated with scene placements; Spawn/home near (0,-27), corral (-50,-50), Tower Gardens centered (57,-26), town square z≈100.

Terrain path marks grade/materialize routes and clear scatter; scene road/path builders draw visible paving and do not replace terrain jobs. Keep curved town-lane marks aligned with its scene geometry and dressing.
The cob-house studio is below the main house floor; art-studio piece origins use feet on studio floor and face -Z; preserve the sunk-studio dry terrain pocket.

Tower Gardens beds and structures use ground feet at y=0.5; greenhouse is centered (58,-33), garden stations/bed coordinates and tower-gardens path/fence layout share the garden data datum. greenhouse beds stay wet during timed growth.

Rowboat bow is local +Z; it is kinematic and movement is constrained by terrain depth/open-water range. Fish animation masks from Spine so seated legs stay put; release/leave clears the fishing children and rider animation.
